Evaluated on the InnoEval benchmark (ICML 2026).
tldr: Proposes Cyclic Cosine Decay Schedule to address Universal training schedule co-occurring in nearly all deep learning experiments (C_obs = 15/40) in Learning Rate Optimization.
limitation: Universal training schedule co-occurring in nearly all deep learning experiments (C_obs = 15/40)
hypothesis: To overcome Universal training schedule co-occurring in nearly all deep learning experiments (C_obs = 15/40) in Learning Rate Optimization, we introduce a knowledge-grounded synthesis combining Cyclic Cosine Decay Schedule with C_obs = 0 null-model pruning and citation maturity validation (citations >= 10).
